ValidationRule.description: Multi-picklist Tags are checked against Priority, Status (ranked by a CASE ladder), approval, notes and contact data, with count ceilings and forbidden combinations.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( INCLUDES(Tags__c, 'Regulated'), OR( NOT(Is_Approved__c), PICKLISTCOUNT(Tags__c) > 3, AND(INCLUDES(Tags__c, 'Pilot'), INCLUDES(Tags__c, 'Strategic')), ISBLANK(Contact_Email__c) ) ), IF( ISBLANK(Tags__c), OR(ISPICKVAL(Priority__c, 'High'), ISPICKVAL(Priority__c, 'Critical')), OR( PICKLISTCOUNT(Tags__c) > CASE(TEXT(Priority__c), 'Low', 1, 'Medium', 2, 'High', 3, 5), AND(INCLUDES(Tags__c, 'External'), INCLUDES(Tags__c, 'Internal'), NOT(INCLUDES(Tags__c, 'Regulated'))) ) ), AND(ISPICKVAL(Priority__c, 'Critical'), CASE(TEXT(Status__c), 'Draft', 0, 'Planning', 1, 'Active', 2, 'On Hold', 2, 'Completed', 3, 'Cancelled', 3, -1) < 1), AND(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Completed'), NULLVALUE(Completion_Pct__c, 0) < 1), AND(CASE(TEXT(Status__c), 'Draft', 0, 'Planning', 1, 'Active', 2, 'On Hold', 2, 'Completed', 3, 'Cancelled', 3, -1) = 2, NOT(Is_Approved__c), CASE(TEXT(Priority__c), 'High', 1, 'Critical', 1, 0) = 1), AND(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'On Hold'), ISBLANK(Notes__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Tags, priority, status, approval and notes are not consistent.
